exclusion_detail: Lead 30ab needs 8 reactions from commercial materials: (1) 4-nitroaniline + 2,4-dichloro-5-fluoropyrimidine -> 22; (2) 4-nitrophenol + 1-bromo-2-chloroethane -> 24a; (3) Fe/NH4Cl reduction -> 25a; (4) coupling of 22 with 25a (TFA) -> 26a; (5) Fe/NH4Cl nitro reduction -> 27a; (6) acryloyl chloride acylation -> 28a; (7) NaI halogen exchange -> 29a; (8) CS2 / 3-(aminomethyl)pyridine / TEA -> 30ab. Every route in the paper (compounds 30, 31, 32) is at least this long.

lead.label: 30ab
lead.why: Abstract: 'Among all these compounds, 30ab (IC50 = 1.15 nM) displays similar or more potent inhibitory activity against BTK than spebrutinib and ibrutinib ... compound 30ab is a candidate for further study.'

notes: Route counted from Scheme 1 (n = 2 side chain, since 30ab is the 2-(...)ethyl ester) and Section 4.1/4.2 of the main text; the SI file holds only NMR spectra. The target SMILES is given for reference only and was not checked against an OPSIN round trip.
